official_title: Man with headphones dancing hip hop style
selection_basis: Original 1fps contact sheet only. Around 8–14 seconds the arms switch among low sweep, raised arms, bent elbow at waist and both hands near head. conversion: nearest frame resample to24fps before trim; preserves physical time to frame quantization, records actual indices
source_family_note: New actor and yellow studio scene relative to car/basketball/bedroom. Same family as51772 if later used.
role: development sample screening, not held-out validation
required_before_inference: Source pose visibility check; retain source rejection if insufficient support.
